items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1960-11-18
items.q: they had nothing called Pruxum. I don't know his right name

ctx.x: Baby Bruce they call him. Yeah, I'll make a note here too. Well Lil' Willie was one of them good piano players around there too. You see, just like I tell you, in them days, a boy like Lil' Willie, Baby Bruce, and they had nothing called Pruxum. I don't know his right name, but you know there's all good piano players around there, but Walter Pichon was class, more class. He could play the stuff they played and he was a musician on the boot of it. But he used to stand, boy, now on two Coca-Cola box then he'd be…
